about: The shared vectors of the checked sale's buyer conditions: each case is a desk-shaped account snapshot and the list the desk reader (polyrob-desk web/checked-sale.js defaults, run by node) builds from it; core's core.wallet.sale_conditions.build must build the same. 'encodings' are the desk's own encoders (web/abi.js) on neutral inputs. Regenerate with the desk checkout: tests/unit/core/wallet/test_sale_conditions.py::test_the_desk_reader_still_builds_the_fixture.
